sources.snippet: Get Started with Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B # Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B (also known as Qwen3.8-Max) features 2.4 trillion total parameters with 95 billion active parameters per token using a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design, a 1-million-token context window, and open-weight availability.
